question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"first."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"First"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it refers to the beginning of something. (सबसे पहला; पहली बार होने वाला; प्रथम)
 
• It is a comparative term, implying that there will be a **"second"** or subsequent item.
 
• The word can be used as both an adjective and adverb, depending on the context.
 
 
• **Example**: *"I was the **first**__ one to arrive at the party."*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct passage**:

I was surprised __**first**__ at the news that my father spared me any thought, and second at my brother's compliment, ______ (2) ______ it was backhanded. Dhri ______ (3) ______ commented on my looks; nor did he encourage me to comment on his. Such useless ______ (4) ______, he believed, made people vain. Was this another ______ (5) ______ of change? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Earlier (पूर्व)"** implies a time before the current moment but does not necessarily refer to the beginning.
 
• **"In the beginning (प्रारंभ में)"** is a valid option, but **"first"** is more concise and commonly used.
 
• **"Second (दूसरा, द्वितीय)"** is the opposite of the correct answer and would not make sense in the given context.
